title: Plastic Surgery Personal Tutor
description: Plastic Surgery Personal Tutor is an open-source, agentic AI tutoring web application for plastic surgery education. It combines a React single-page frontend with Supabase Edge Functions that orchestrate Google Gemini models for text chat and real-time audio tutoring, and a graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (Graph RAG) pipeline built on LightRAG and OpenAI embeddings over a curated corpus of plastic surgery textbooks and journal articles indexed into a knowledge graph of clinical entities and relationships. The system grounds every answer in the indexed medical literature via pgvector similarity search and one-hop knowledge-graph traversal, guarding against hallucination, and adds agentic capabilities: training-level-adaptive instruction (medical student through senior resident), autonomous clinical-vignette and multiple-choice quiz generation from recently studied topics, multilingual audio tutoring, and progress tracking. The software is intended as a research artifact for studying AI-assisted surgical education and as a reusable template any training program can index with its own curriculum.
